evidence.reason: The fresh-host path still aborts before the first-tick polling can wait. In `two_slot_health`, line 1407 evaluates `first_tick = _tick_value(effects)` before calling `observe(first_tick)` at line 1408; if `heartbeat.json` is absent, `_tick_value` raises before the bounded polling callback runs. The same missing-heartbeat abort also occurs in `health_observation` at line 1375, which `wait_for_first_tick` calls. This contradicts the existing `--first-tick-timeout-seconds` waiting behavior; the fix is to use that budget to wait for an initially absent heartbeat while still rejecting unreadable/foreign heartbeats and requiring the second advancing tick.
